dialogues.speaker: Furina
dialogues.text: Ah, yet another view that evokes for me the times when I graced the stage of the Opera Epiclese.

dialogues.speaker: Furina
dialogues.text: You seem... perplexed? Hmph, the mist from the fountain is my curtain, the abundant blossoms my stage: A star performer is always ready to sing for an adoring crowd, wheresoever she may roam.
